notes: Orange Tree (orangetree.in) is a Shopify store. Direct HTTP fetch worked throughout (200s, no WAF/bot-block); robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow -- it explicitly names and allows anthropic-ai/Claude-Web/GPTBot/CCBot for crawling public product pages. Site also publishes an AI-agent onboarding file at /agents.md (UCP/Shop-skill commerce-agent instructions, irrelevant to this PLP-extraction task and not acted on). Discovery: enumerated the FULL collections.json catalog (300 collections across 2 pages, limit=250) rather than relying on site search, then checked main nav (top-level items: Gifting/Bestsellers/Blogs/Trade Program/Design Projects/Our Stores/Franchise Enquiry), the 'SHOP BY CATEGORY' mega-menu accordion, homepage, and the furniture/lighting/decor/wall-decor category pages for actual hrefs, plus sitemap_collections_1.xml (240 of the 300 collections are listed there). Found 4 collections matching bestseller-type title/handle: furniture-best-seller ('Bestsellers', 25 exact), best-seller ('Best Seller', 42 exact), best-sellers ('Best Sellers', 16 exact), best-seller-products ('Best Sellers', 12 exact). Only /collections/furniture-best-seller is actually linked anywhere found: it is the main-nav TOP-LEVEL item literally labelled 'Bestsellers' (sits alongside Gifting/Blogs/Trade Program, not nested under Furniture), and the identical link recurs on the furniture, lighting, decor and wall-decor category pages -- so despite its URL handle it is the site's real, actively-promoted Bestsellers PLP (content is mixed, mostly furniture plus at least one mirror, not furniture-exclusive). The other 3 collections are NOT linked in main nav, homepage, any category page checked, footer, or sitemap_collections.xml -- they appear orphaned/legacy. ID-overlap check rules out them being simple aliases of the nav-linked page or of each other (furniture-best-seller vs best-seller: 12/42 shared; vs best-sellers: 5/16 shared; vs best-seller-products: 0/12 shared), so they are recorded below with MANUAL REVIEW flags rather than silently dropped or silently trusted. Every qty is the EXACT unique-product-id count from exhaustive pagination of /collections/<handle>/products.json (limit=250, deduped by numeric id) -- the site's own cached collections.json products_count is inflated for all 4 handles (e.g. furniture-best-seller cached 72 vs exact 25; best-seller cached 132 vs exact 42; best-sellers cached 37 vs exact 16), matching the known Shopify products_count-unreliable pattern documented for this exact store in the prior Home-Decor pass (notes/268.md).

Confirmed NOT an alias of the nav-linked furniture-best-seller (only 12 of 42 ids overlap). Human should confirm current customer-reachability before deciding whether to include.
